description: A strongly-typed EXTERNAL type declaration (ISO §2023:13.18.22.3 SR1/SR5; §2023:8.5.3; Annex E.3 item 10) — a COBOL-2023 addition. E.3 item 10 states external items 'could not be strongly typed' before 2023, so it is specifically the STRONG+EXTERNAL combination on a level-1 TYPEDEF that is new; SR5 forces a strongly-typed external record's type to itself be a strong external type declaration. A WEAK 'TYPEDEF IS EXTERNAL' (no STRONG) was already valid in COBOL-2002 (§2023:13.18.58.3 SR3) and is NOT gated. Gated on the co-occurrence of the EXTERNAL clause with a STRONG TYPEDEF clause on one level-1 data description entry. Below 2023 the strong external type declaration is rejected.
vcr: VCR row 63 (strongly-typed EXTERNAL type declaration — 2023 introduction; weak external TYPEDEF stays COBOL-2002)
